*871United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Reed, and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
